title: Quenched Jamaican Rice Grill
description: A smoky, tender grilled rice dish with melted colby jack cheese, perfect for a crowd-pleasing Jamaican dinner.
instructions: Rinse 1 cup brown rice under cold water until the water runs clear.
In a medium pot, combine the rinsed rice with 2 cups water, bring to a boil, then reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 40 minutes until tender.
While the rice cooks, preheat the robata grill to medium-high heat and lightly oil the grates with coconut oil.
Once the rice is cooked, fluff it with a fork and stir in 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp salt, and 1/2 tsp pepper.
Transfer the seasoned rice onto a heat‑proof grill pan or directly onto the grill grates and spread it evenly.
Sprinkle 1 cup shredded colby jack cheese over the hot rice, then cover the grill pan with a lid to trap heat.
Grill for 5–7 minutes until the cheese melts and the rice develops a slightly smoky crust.
Remove from the grill, drizzle with 1 tbsp lime juice, sprinkle chopped cilantro, and serve hot.
